Package com.nexuslink.protocol.snmp

Class SnmpService

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.snmp.SnmpService
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class SnmpService extends Object implements AutoCloseable
SNMP browser client over SNMP4J — community-based v1 / v2c GET and WALK (GETNEXT) over UDP, plus SNMPv3 / USM GET and WALK (getV3(com.nexuslink.protocol.snmp.SnmpV3Config, java.lang.String, java.lang.String...), walkV3(com.nexuslink.protocol.snmp.SnmpV3Config, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, int)). Returns decoded variable bindings (OID, SMI type, value) for display. Blocking I/O; the UI drives it on a background task.

The pure helpers — versionOf(java.lang.String), normalizeAddress(java.lang.String, int), isValidOid(java.lang.String) and toVarBind(org.snmp4j.smi.VariableBinding) — are unit-tested offline; live GET/WALK needs a reachable SNMP agent. The v3 USM mapping lives in SnmpV3Usm (config → SNMP4J auth/priv OIDs, security level, UsmUser) and is unit-tested offline.

    • getV3

      public List<SnmpService.VarBind> getV3(SnmpV3Config cfg, String host, String... oids) throws IOException
      Performs an SNMPv3 GET for one or more OIDs against host (UDP port 161) using the USM security parameters in cfg. A fresh v3 session — with a local engine ID, the configured UsmUser and a UserTarget — is opened for the call and closed on return. The response decoding is shared with the v1 / v2c get(java.lang.String...) path.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if cfg is null or fails SnmpV3Config.validate()
      IOException
